exposure: Platelet count (normal: 150 k/microliter or greater, mild thrombocytopenia: 100-149 k/microliter)
outcome: Total blood loss 1,000 mL or greater
Use of uterotonic agents (methylergonovine maleate or carboprost tromethamine)
cohort: 2,845 nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex pregnancies undergoing labor
finding: Nulliparous women with mild thrombocytopenia (platelet count 100-149 k/microliter) had a twofold greater likelihood of postpartum hemorrhage compared with those with normal platelet count.
